design_philosophy: Premium, minimal, futuristic UI. Deep black (#0B0B0F) canvas with intentional, high-contrast purple and blue gradient glows. Glassmorphism cards with generous padding, 'Stripe/Notion AI' level of polish, emphasizing execution-first exclusivity.

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-7xl font-semibold tracking-tighter text-white
rules.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-medium tracking-tight text-white

layout_spacing.bento_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 md:gap-8

buttons.primary: relative group overflow-hidden bg-white text-black rounded-full px-8 py-3.5 font-semibold transition-all hover:scale-[1.02] hover:shadow-[0_0_40px_rgba(139,92,246,0.4)]
buttons.secondary: bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3.5 font-medium hover:bg-white/10 transition-all
buttons.gradient_border: relative p-[1px] bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-500 to-blue-500 rounded-full

cards.glass: bg-[#12121A]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/5 rounded-3xl p-8 hover:bg-white/[0.04] hover:border-purple-500/30 transition-all duration-500 relative overflow-hidden group

header.style: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#0B0B0F]/60 border-b border-white/5 transition-all duration-300

sections.Hero: Center-aligned content. Massive 'Outfit' heading. Background MUST have CSS radial gradients (deep purple/blue) glowing behind the text. Include dual CTAs: 'Apply for Early Access' (Primary) and 'Join WhatsApp Community' (Secondary).
sections.Agents: Grid of 6 bento cards. Content: Trend Scout, Retention Strategy, Viral Scriptwriter, Content Strategy, Monetization, Visual Story. Each needs a glowing Lucide icon, subtle glassmorphism, and a hover reveal effect (e.g., border glow).
sections.HowItWorks: 3 steps (Apply, Get Selected, Deploy Agents). Render as horizontal cards or a vertical timeline connected by a glowing line.
sections.WhyDeployrAI: Focus on 'execution-first' differentiation. Use a two-column layout: left column sticky heading, right column scrolling key benefits with large numbers.
sections.Results: Showcase metrics (e.g., 10x output, faster execution) using text-5xl numbers in a visually dense, high-contrast block.
sections.Community: A prominent section with a dark-gradient background inviting users to the first wave. Include WhatsApp integration CTA.
sections.WaitlistForm: Sleek inline form or embedded Shadcn Form. Fields: Name, Email, Content Type, Platform, Goal. Inputs must be dark with `focus:ring-purple-500`.
sections.OutputProof: Showcase what users built using the system. Use the provided Pexels workspace image with a dark gradient overlay to blend into the #0B0B0F background.
sections.Footer: Minimalist, generous spacing (py-20), dark grey text.
sections.ViralLoop: Add a 'Share this' or 'Refer a Creator' floating widget or section near the waitlist confirmation.

hero_texture.description: Abstract purple and black wavy lines to be used at low opacity (10-15%) to texture the background of the hero or form section.

output_proof.description: Sleek creator desk setup with purple lighting. Use in the 'Built With the System' / Output Proof section.

community_avatar.description: Filmmaker portrait to be used as a thumbnail or avatar near the waitlist or community CTA to add social proof.

animations.hover: Cards should translate-y-[-2px] and reveal a subtle glow. Use Tailwind group-hover.
animations.scroll: Staggered fade-in for grid items using Framer Motion (initial opacity 0, y 20).
animations.tracing_beam: Use a moving gradient border effect for the primary pricing or 'How it Works' cards.

testing: All interactive elements (buttons, form inputs, links) MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="apply-early-access-button"`).
instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure you add `Outfit` and `Manrope` from Google Fonts to the HTML. Customize tailwind.config.js to include the custom colors and fonts. All sections should strictly follow the dark #0B0B0F base. Do not use generic Shadcn default borders (gray-200); override them with white/10 or white/5. Do not use `Inter` for headings.
